## Goal
- Safely reconcile local IVX work with canonical `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, complete CI, deploy the exact merged SHA, and prove live production QA and SHA parity.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use canonical GitHub repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` as source of truth.
- Do not deploy the divergent local checkout.
- Before any reset, merge, checkout, or overwrite, preserve all local commits, uncommitted changes, stashes, and untracked files using a backup branch, recovery tag, and patch/bundle.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities.
- Do not merge while required CI is failed, skipped, cancelled, or running.
- Do not mark complete until:
  ```text
  GitHub HEAD SHA = GitHub Actions SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA
  ```
- Do not certify primary AI while public chat reports:
  ```text
  source="fallback"
  ```
- Final response must contain only the user-specified provenance, deployment, QA evidence, and blockers fields.

## Progress
### Done
- Fresh public production verification:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/readiness → 200
  https://ivxholding.com → 200
  https://chat.ivxholding.com → 200
  ```
- Live runtime evidence:
  ```text
  health.status=healthy
  health.environment=production
  health.version=ivx-owner-ai-backend-v2026.07.26
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  readiness.status=ok
  readiness.ready=true
  ```
- Public chat smoke test:
  ```text
  POST /api/public/chat → 200
  answer="The answer is 4."
  source="fallback"
  model="ivx-ia-conversation-brain"
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Public access-control and validation QA:
  ```text
  GET /api/ivx/owner-ai/status → 401
  OPTIONS /api/members/verification/phone → 204
  POST /api/members/register with {} → stage=VALIDATING, code=INVALID_EMAIL
  ```
- Locked dependencies restored:
  ```text
  bun install --frozen-lockfile
  261 packages installed
  ```
- Local regression gates completed:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  ```
  - Focused tests: `38 pass, 0 fail`.
  - Full Expo test suite: passed.
- Local OTP/member-authentication hardening completed:
  - `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` uses salted scrypt hashes, TTL, attempts, resend limits/cooldown, cleanup, and production durable-store fail-closed behavior.
  - Source marker:
    ```text
    DEPLOYMENT_MARKER=ivx-member-verification-v4-secure-persistence
    ```
- Certification audit plan updated:
  ```text
  .rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md
  ```
- GitHub credential injection was requested without exposing its value:
  ```text
  GITHUB_TOKEN
  ```
  - An already-configured secret was not available to the runtime:
    ```text
    github_token_runtime=missing
    ```
  - A forced replacement request is awaiting approved user input.

### In Progress
- Restore canonical GitHub owner access and collect repository metadata, default branch, HEAD SHA, commits, Actions runs, and pull requests.
- Safe source-of-truth reconciliation workflow is planned but has not begun; no local reset, merge, checkout, overwrite, or deployment has been performed.

### Blocked
- Canonical GitHub cannot be inspected from this runner until an approved credential is injected:
  ```text
  github_token_runtime=missing
  GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  canonical_github_anonymous_http=404
  ```
- The current forced secret request is:
  ```text
  GITHUB_TOKEN
  ```
  with required repository permissions: Contents read/write, Pull requests read/write, Actions read, Workflows read/write.
- Render deploy history and deployed SHA cannot be inspected:
  ```text
  RENDER_API_KEY=missing
  ```
- Authenticated owner/member success paths cannot be exercised:
  ```text
  IVX_OWNER_TOKEN=missing
  ```
- Owner Variables runtime bridge cannot resolve deployment values because its database URL is absent:
  ```text
  Owner Variables database URL is missing. Set [redacted], SUPABASE_DB_URL, DATABASE_URL, or POSTGRES_URL.
  ```
- No independent proof exists for:
  ```text
  GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA
  ```
- Local checkout differs from live production SHA; it must not be deployed before canonical comparison and reconciliation:
  ```text
  live SHA=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Expo lint remains a release-gate failure:
  ```text
  $ bunx expo lint
  Error: Cannot find module 'eslint'
  error: script "lint" exited with code 1
  ```
- Public chat operates in fallback mode; primary AI service is not certified.
- Mobile/web E2E, Android/iOS emulator tests, signed release builds, and SHA-matched installation proof remain unexecuted.
- OTP durable schema repair requires unavailable service-role credentials:
  ```text
  schema repair requires the service-role key, which is not configured
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Canonical GitHub is the sole source of truth; no local work may replace it wholesale.
- Do not perform any local destructive or history-changing action until backup branch, recovery tag, preservation of uncommitted/stashed/untracked files, and patch/bundle recovery evidence exist.
- Treat `/health`, `/version`, and `/readiness` as proof of a healthy live runtime at `012bb088...`, not proof of GitHub, Actions, or Render provenance.
- Treat `401` responses as access-control guard proof only; they do not validate authenticated success paths.
- Treat `stage=VALIDATING, code=INVALID_EMAIL` as public invalid-input contract proof only.
- Do not deploy current local source because it differs from the live SHA and canonical GitHub has not been authenticated or compared.
- Record the Expo lint result as a release-gate failure until `eslint` is properly declared and installed.
- Treat focused regressions and full Expo tests as passing local gates; they do not establish production provenance.
- Never claim SHA parity or production certification until all four SHA sources independently match.

## Next Steps
- 1. Receive functioning approved `GITHUB_TOKEN` injection for owner `ibb142`, then retrieve canonical repository metadata, default branch, HEAD SHA, latest commits, Actions runs, and pull requests.
- 2. Before any reconciliation action, create a complete local backup branch and recovery tag; preserve working tree, stashes, untracked files, local commits, and export a patch or bundle.
- 3. Compare canonical GitHub `main`, live production SHA `012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c`, and current local SHA; identify commits, files, conflicts, and approved undeployed work.
- 4. If canonical GitHub matches production, create a clean branch from canonical HEAD and selectively apply approved local changes; otherwise recover the production commit into canonical GitHub and retain newer work on a recovery branch.
- 5. Repair Expo lint dependency configuration, then rerun:
  ```text
  bun --cwd expo run lint
  ```
- 6. Run type check, lint, unit, integration, registration, authentication, and production build gates on the exact reconciliation candidate SHA.
- 7. Push candidate branch, open PR, run GitHub Actions, repair all required failures, and merge only when all required jobs are green.
- 8. Obtain Render access, verify Render is connected to `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` on the correct production branch, deploy the exact merged SHA, and record deployment ID.
- 9. Prove:
  ```text
  GitHub HEAD SHA = GitHub Actions SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA
  ```
- 10. Execute authorized production member/owner authentication QA, Android/iOS/web QA, session QA, and primary-AI-without-fallback QA.

## Critical Context
- Canonical repository:
  ```text
  https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  ```
- Production identifiers:
  ```text
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  version=ivx-owner-ai-backend-v2026.07.26
  ```
- Expected Render service:
  ```text
  srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  ```
- Current `origin` is a Rork router, not direct canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- The GitHub API access command was intentionally designed not to print the token:
  ```text
  curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" ...
  ```
  and failed before API access with:
  ```text
  github_token_runtime=missing
  ```
- `package.json` declares `ai`, `@types/bun`, `@types/node`, and `typescript`; dependency restoration used:
  ```text
  bun install --frozen-lockfile
  ```
- Focused tests may emit non-fatal Owner Variables bridge warnings where no database URL is configured.
- Expo lint resolves a temporary Expo CLI and fails due to missing `eslint`.
- Existing OTP implementation uses `randomInt`, `scryptSync`, and `timingSafeEqual`; stored verification records use salted scrypt hashes, not plaintext.
- `expo/package.json` previously observed:
  ```text
  version=1.4.8
  ```
- Generate release metadata only from the final canonical merged SHA.

## Relevant Files
- `package.json`: root declared dependency set and local regression prerequisites.
- `bun.lock`: locked dependencies restored via `bun install --frozen-lockfile`.
- `expo/package.json`: Expo scripts and missing ESLint release-gate dependency context.
- `backend/hono.ts`: route registration, CORS, middleware, member endpoints, and protected IVX route wiring.
- `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`: owner-only GitHub/Render deploy-control operations and credential/runtime dependencies.
- `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`: bearer-token member binding for verification, profile, KYC, and related member endpoints.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`: OTP hashing, TTL, attempts, resend cooldown, cleanup, durable persistence, production fail-closed behavior, and `ivx-member-verification-v4-secure-persistence` marker.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-database.ts`: member/auth persistence and service-role versus anon-key fallback review.
- `backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts`: idempotent member registration workflow and error contracts.
- `backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts`: registration contract coverage.
- `backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts`: deployment/rollback regression coverage.
- `backend/public-chat-ai.ts`: public-chat provider source reporting, primary generation, fallback, and persistence.
- `backend/ivx-ai-runtime.ts`: AI gateway configuration and `ai` package import.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: server-side owner authorization guard using `resolveIVXAuthenticatedRequest`.
- `expo/shared/ivx/access-control.ts`: shared authenticated request resolution and bearer-token extraction.
- `backend/supabase/migrations/enterprise_indexes.sql`: verification-code index; no confirmed table-creation migration.
- `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md`: current certification evidence, SHA conflict, and provenance blockers.

responseMessageContents.text:
You’re right to be frustrated. The screenshot confirms the secrets are saved in the project, and I should not have treated that as you failing to configure them.

The issue is a separate execution-boundary failure: this agent sandbox receives **none** of those saved server-side variables (`GITHUB_TOKEN`, `RENDER_API_KEY`, Supabase, or owner session), so it cannot use them despite their presence in the Secrets panel. I will not ask you to paste them.

I have moved work forward safely: recovery protection is now created at local SHA `fed993712b3414d286e8960cdd573c461114fac3`:
- backup branch: `recovery/pre-reconciliation-20260803T160603Z`
- recovery tag: `recovery/pre-reconciliation-20260803T160603Z`
- full bundle: `recovery/ivx-pre-reconciliation-20260803T160603Z.bundle`

No reset, overwrite, push, or deployment has occurred. The remaining blocker is Rork’s secret-to-agent-runtime injection, not missing credentials.
